_comment: Cards that exist only for the imprint-characteristics test (tests/unit/statics/test_imprint_characteristics.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_duplicant` is the Duplicant shape: its enters trigger exiles a nontoken creature with a link, and its static takes the last linked creature card's power, toughness and creature types. `t_star_beast` is a */* creature card whose characteristic-defining ability must still count in exile (604.3).

cards.name: Test Duplicant
cards.oracle_text:
Imprint — When this creature enters, you may exile target nontoken creature.
As long as a card exiled with this creature is a creature card, this creature has the power, toughness, and creature types of the last creature card exiled with it. It's still a Shapeshifter.
